signature: “MACHT SEBASTIAN HAINLEIN DER . IVNGER . 16.22 NVRNBERG”. master’s mark: recumbent cock with initials “S. H.” and Nuremberg crest. On bell, above garland, Lodron family coat of arms (lion without tail).
dimensions: bo 12.5, be 120, le 4385, h 1560, mouthpipe 11.5, tube in secondary coil 955 long, 13.5 in bore¹
provenance: ; ex Archbishop Paris Lodron; acquired in 1846 from Musikgesellschaft in Henndorf.
literature: Geiringer 1932: 30; Birsak 1977: 29, tafel XII (photo); Wörthmüller 1955: 444; Waterhouse 1993:155; Birsak 2004.
remarks: Good condition. Looped secondary coil of tubing before bell. Immoveable slide stay later manufacture; moveable slide-stay missing in photo in Birsak 1977. Nuremberg-style garland, 35mm wide, with signature, fine engraving and ornamented border. Ferrules richly decorated. Tubular slide stays; handle missing. Tubular stay in secondary coil. Finely decorated flat bell stay, fixed on bell-pipe side with hinge. Little flare in bell. Ring in slide-bow.
